name: praxis
description: A coherent engineering workflow framework for coding agents: discussion, context, planning, execution, review, verification, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: A disciplined engineering workflow for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Use Praxis to route software work through the right amount of discussion, exploration, durable context, planning, execution, review, verification, and delivery. Praxis defaults local artifacts to .agents/ while respecting repository conventions such as Linear, GitHub issues, or committed documentation.
defaultPrompt: Use Praxis for this engineering task.
Let's plan and build this with Praxis.
Use Praxis to continue this work.
